scope: links_with_no_anchor_text: literal attribute insertion, not complete correction acceptance
changes: Replace regex anchor matching with HTMLParser plus an exact quoted-attribute lexer.
Insert only an aria-label at the actual href attribute offset; preserve other bytes, case, quotes and line endings.
Do not confuse data-href, namespaced attributes or a href decoy inside another attribute with the real href.
Preserve comments, script/style data, templates and other non-rendered contexts.
Preserve existing accessible names, image alt text and aria-labelledby, including uncertain existing declarations.
A named link elsewhere exonerates empty links with the same literal href, without guessing URL equivalence.
Refuse conflicting/untyped evidence, uncertain dynamic content, malformed nesting and duplicate attributes.
Bound source and output to 80000 UTF-8 bytes and require idempotence.
Remove the unsupported comment promising that Google uses aria-label as anchor text.

red_initial.note: A huge generated test ID exceeded the Windows environment-variable limit at setup. These setup errors are harness errors, not corrector defects.

red_after_shortening_only_the_test_id.note: The pre-change app is frozen in the red manifest. Repeated parameterized witnesses are not 101 independent product defects.

first_green_attempt.note: The initial parser accepted an unfinished comment and refused an image with empty alt. Product handling was corrected; expectations were not weakened.

first_browser_attempt.note: BrowserContext.new_page does not take viewport. The harness now sets the page viewport explicitly. No successful check.json was emitted by this attempt.

final_tests.environment: Windows Python 3.13, isolated temporary SQLite databases, workers disabled, real provider keys blank

browser_countercheck.engine: Real local Playwright Chromium; independent DOM, accessible-role and PNG checks
browser_countercheck.note: Counts measure a real accessible name on this local witness, not crawler issue totals or Google indexing.

inventory.note: This intentionally non-validation-prefixed local receipt does not promote this issue family or reduce named-record gaps. Mentions are not successful repairs.

not_certified: The existing prepare path still trusts report evidence; served source and destination names are not re-attested by this phase.
This family does not yet have a protected source/route/destination plan, including through free-form or old previews.
Relative href meaning across shared components and routes remains to be proven.
The parser is not a JavaScript/JSX/Vue/Astro compiler or a complete rendered accessible-name algorithm.
Conservative literal refusal can leave valid optional-end-tag, unquoted or dynamic HTML uncorrected.
CSS depending on aria-label can change other sites' appearance; fixture pixel equality is not universal.
No deployed fixture, production crawl, live Google validation, real Claude response or fresh PostgreSQL acceptance was run.
Corrector-wide client readiness is not certified.
